preamble: Denasalization and lowering of the nasalized close front vowel [ĩ] to the close-mid front vowel [e]. This shift involves loss of nasality combined with lowering of vowel height, occurring in Slavic languages through denasalization processes and vowel quality shifts in historical phonological change.

examples.note: Proto-Slavic nasalized high vowels underwent denasalization with lowering, as seen in the development of Old Church Slavic and modern Polish nasal vowel systems.

sources: Wikipedia contributors (2026). Phonological history of French. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phonological_history_of_French
